Answer: B
Reason: The initial chest X-ray (Figure 1) demonstrates a large right-sided pleural effusion causing a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift. The second image (Figure 3) shows a worsening of this opacity with further leftward displacement of the mediastinum, indicating an increase in the collection size. The final postoperative image (Figure 4) shows complete resolution of the effusion and return of the mediastinum to the midline.
